It is a 1x1 Verilog tile with no further test or hardware information provided.

results.summary_before: This Wokwi design implements a simple padlock or safe code lock that displays status on a seven-segment display. The user sets a code using switches, locks and unlocks with another switch, and enters the code with a push button. The design includes a reset switch and an LED to indicate locked status; testing involves simulating the switch and button sequences in Wokwi. It is a basic educational example of a code-based lock with minimal documentation beyond the controls description.

results.summary_before: This project is a configurable PWM generator whose duty cycle is selected by three digital input signals, with an enable input and a clock. The duty cycle steps in 12.5% increments from 12.5% to 100% depending on the three-bit combination, and the PWM signal appears on a single output pin. Testing requires a signal generator for a 10MHz clock and an oscilloscope to observe the pulse width. The documentation is in Spanish and provides a clear truth table, but no silicon test results are reported.
